en: The Triplet on the Visible (Sanidassanattika) and the Couple on Association with the Taints (Āsavasampayuttaduka).

Dependent on a state associated with the taints (*āsava*), there arise states that are neither visible nor impinging and are not associated with the taints, through the condition of root-cause (*hetu-paccaya*).
(Abbreviated. There are six [relations] under root-cause, three under object (*ārammaṇa*) … pe … six under non-disappearance (*avigata*).

Dependent on a state that is non-demonstrable, non-reactive, and dissociated from the taints (*āsava*), there arises a state that is neither demonstrable nor reactive and not dissociated from the taints, by way of root condition.
